notes: All 25 candidates reviewed from the saved text files; none is a doctoral graduate or placement list and none is an in-scope single record. TU Berlin (8): two chair thesis pages list only bachelor's/master's/student-project theses (TDS chair in Faculty VII business school, 2022; water resources engineering chair, 2020-2022, page 1 of 6), the strategic-leadership chair page captured only its navigation shell, two are library dissertation-publishing checklists, two are robotics-lab ongoing/open student thesis pages, one is a news item advertising thesis topics. TU Clausthal (17): four CZM book-series pages are single dissertation records (Wegewitz 2015, Kerl 2018, Sonnenberg 2019, Wurlitzer 2021) in materials engineering with no placement; they are marked not-a-list under the out-of-field rule rather than single-record, so an integrator who keeps out-of-field dissertation records should reclassify those four. Thirteen ISSE pages are staff profiles of current research assistants/doctoral candidates in software engineering (Prof. Rausch's groups), three with a vita, none stating a completed doctorate or a placement. Institutions by host were kept as given for all pages.
